chunks: And with the former chain of narration from Ali ibn Mahzyar, from Fadhalah, from Ismail, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) used to say: "Awaken your heart through reflection, let your side forsake sleep, and fear Allah, your Lord."

key_terms.التفكر: Tafakkur: deep reflection and contemplation, considered one of the highest forms of worship in Islamic tradition
key_terms.تقوى: Taqwa: God-consciousness, piety, guarding oneself against sins and disobedience

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about awakening the heart through reflection?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) transmits a recurring exhortation of Imam Ali (AS), who was known for his night vigils and deep spiritual reflection. The three commands form a concise program for spiritual awakening: contemplation (tafakkur), reducing excessive sleep to make time for worship, and cultivating God-consciousness (taqwa). In the context of Shia tradition, these instructions were directed at believers seeking nearness to God through inner spiritual discipline.
word_analysis: and with the chain of narration
